headword: {膠着|こうちゃく}{状態|じょうたい}
reading: こうちゃくじょうたい

definitions.explanation: A situation where no progress can be made because opposing sides are evenly matched or unwilling to compromise. Used for negotiations, conflicts, competitions, and political situations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{膠着|こうちゃく}{状態|じょうたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}った→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧。
examples.english: The negotiations fell into a deadlock.

examples.japanese: {両軍|りょうぐん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{膠着|こうちゃく}{状態|じょうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The battle between the two armies remains in a stalemate.

examples.japanese: {膠着|こうちゃく}{状態|じょうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打破|だは}→打破：12808_daha⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: A new proposal is needed to break through the deadlock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{膠着|こうちゃく}{状態|じょうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解|と}け→解ける：04371_tokeru⟧ず、⟦{延長戦|えんちょうせん}→延長戦：06540_enchousen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{突入|とつにゅう}→突入：13777_totsunyuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Even going into the second half, the stalemate didn't break, and the game went into overtime.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{膠着|こうちゃく}→膠着：13935_kouchaku⟧ (adhesion; being stuck) and ⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (state; condition). {膠|こう} originally means glue, so ⟦{膠着|こうちゃく}→膠着：13935_kouchaku⟧ literally means "glued together" — vividly describing a situation where things are stuck and cannot move.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {膠着|こうちゃく}{状態|じょうたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧: to fall into a deadlock
- {膠着|こうちゃく}{状態|じょうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: the stalemate continues
- {膠着|こうちゃく}{状態|じょうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打破|だは}→打破：12808_daha⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to break through a deadlock
- {膠着|こうちゃく}{状態|じょうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打開|だかい}→打開：09347_dakai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to break open an impasse
- {膠着|こうちゃく}{状態|じょうたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解|と}ける→解ける：04371_tokeru⟧: the stalemate breaks

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{行|い}き{詰|づ}まり→行き詰まり：08033_ikizumari⟧: deadlock; impasse — more conversational, often used for personal or business situations
- {手詰|てづ}まり: being at a loss; dead end — implies running out of options, not necessarily two opposing sides
- こう{着|ちゃく}: stalemate (abbreviated form) — sometimes used alone in news headlines
